about_the_game:
Very Disco, Disco Very!

Plan your moves. Lock them in. Watch the chaos unfold.

Very Disco, Disco Very! is a 1–8 player tactical party game where everyone programs their moves simultaneously. Each round, players plan a 6-step sequence, then lock it in. Once the turn begins, the physics take over.

Pushes, slides, shifting tiles, and player collisions mean your perfect strategy rarely survives contact with the dance floor.

And that is exactly the point.

The Flow of the Game: Calm vs Chaos

Matches move in waves of strategy and madness.

Some rounds are calm and tactical, letting players position themselves and plan ahead. But every shove, collision, and chaotic interaction fills the Boogie Meter.

When the meter reaches its limit, Disco Mode triggers.

The music kicks in, the arena lights up, and Mystery Boxes begin dropping everywhere.

If you want the best items, you will need to create some chaos.

The Mystery Box Dilemma

Every Mystery Box contains a Mutation. These are not simple power-ups. Each one changes how your character behaves on the dance floor.

Examples include:

Asteroid Pet Rock
Become completely immovable and impossible to push. In exchange, you lose the ability to sprint.

Plasma Slinky
Walk safely over deadly pits. However, you can no longer move backward.

Black Hole Marble
Spin 450 degrees to teleport instantly. The trade-off: you permanently lose the ability to turn left.

Photon Bubblegum
Every forward move becomes a high-speed burst, turning you into a speed specialist who cannot slow down.

Every mutation is powerful, but it always comes with a strange new limitation.

The 3S Card System: Hold vs Burn

Each move slot (1–6) has its own linear skill tree. You decide how your power grows during the match.

Collect

Pick up Mystery Boxes to receive items and 3S Cards:

  • Social

  • Selfish

  • Sadistic

Each category introduces different types of effects and strategies.

Invest

Holding onto cards generates Skill Points over time. These points can be spent to permanently upgrade individual move slots.

Upgrades unlock abilities such as:

  • Shooting mechanics

  • Special shots

  • Spawning cows

  • Disco meteorites

  • Mind control effects

The Burn

To activate powerful abilities, you must play a matching card in that slot.

However, playing a card resets your progress toward the next Skill Point.

This creates a constant decision:

Use your power now to survive, or hold your cards and grow stronger for the final rounds.

Built for the Groove

Very Disco, Disco Very! is designed to feel like a living, reactive dance floor.

Director-Grade Camera
An automated camera system that anticipates the biggest collisions and highlights chaotic moments while always respecting manual player control.

Music Player
Customize the soundtrack that drives your matches.

Custom Color Manager
Fine-tune the game’s visual style by adjusting shadows, midtones, and highlights in real time.

Custom Keybinds

Localization Support

Game Features

1–8 Players
Local multiplayer or online party matches.

Simultaneous Tactical Turns
Plan your 6-step sequence and lock it in before the action begins.

3S Card System
Social, Selfish, and Sadistic cards that constantly twist the rules of the game.

Physics-Driven Chaos
Movement, collisions, and environmental interactions create unpredictable outcomes.

Disco Dossier
Collect and browse every card, mutation, and item in the game.

Plan carefully. Lock it in. Then watch the chaos begin.
